description: Calculate a fair sponsorship rate for a creator deal using OCRS (the Open Creator Rate Standard): Fair Rate = BMV × CM × RM × QA × MA, returned with a confidence band and full multiplier breakdown. This is FREE — it costs ZERO credits and never scrapes or scores anyone; it's pure sourced math over inputs you provide. Minimal call needs only platform, median_views, and niche; everything else defaults to a neutral choice (LinkedIn formats take median IMPRESSIONS). Optionally pass actual_paid to check whether an offer lands within/above/below the fair band. For a cross-platform PACKAGE (the same campaign posted to several platforms) pass `package` — one line per extra platform with that platform's own median views and how the asset gets there (crosspost / adapted / native) — and you get the package total, its band, and each line. Use this for 'what should I charge / pay for a sponsored post?'.

actualPaid.description: Optional: an actual quoted/paid amount to compare against the fair band (the package total when package is given).

concept.description: Production concept: ugc < scripted < branded < cinematic. Default ugc.

deliverables.description: How many deliverables in the package. Default 1.

engagementRate.description: Engagement rate as a percent, e.g. 6.2. Defaults to the niche benchmark.

medianViews.description: The creator's typical (median) views per post for this format (median impressions for LinkedIn).

niche.description: Content niche (drives ER benchmark + market factor).

deliverables.description: Deliverables on this platform, e.g. story frames.

medianViews.description: THIS platform's own median views (impressions for LinkedIn).

platform.description: Extra platform the campaign is cross-posted to.

reuse.description: crosspost = same file re-posted (default); adapted = native re-cut from the same shoot; native = separately shot content.

postCount.description: Sample size behind the metrics. Smaller samples widen the band. Default 30.

rightsTier.description: Usage rights tier: organic < whitelisting_90d < paid_6mo < paid_12mo. Default organic.

name: calculate_fair_rate
